annotation.title_clean: PART 124—Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System Authority for State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial Law Enforcement and Correctional Agencies
annotation.title_en: PART 124—Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System Authority for State, Local, Tribal, and Territorial Law Enforcement and Correctional Agencies
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Department of Homeland Security and Department of Justice
annotation.venue: Federal Register / Code of Federal Regulations (6 CFR and 28 CFR part 124)
annotation.summary_en: Federal regulation implementing the SAFER SKIES Act authority for state, local, tribal and territorial law enforcement and correctional agencies to detect, track, warn and mitigate threatening drones. It sets credible-threat and proportionality standards, FBI-run NCUTC certification, authorized technology lists, FAA/FCC coordination, reporting, privacy and data-retention limits, and compliance enforcement.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mitigation requires NCUTC Mitigation Certification and a Part 107 certificate, and operators keep independent judgment.
Mitigation requires a credible threat determination and a proportionate, least-disruptive response.
Agencies must use only Authorized Technologies List categories and Authorized Systems List systems.
Advance notification (30 days), signed Operations Plan, FAA/FCC coordination, and 48-hour post-operation reports are required.
Control communications may be retained at most 180 days, with First and Fourth Amendment protections; authority terminates December 31, 2031.
